subject: english
stem: A school report says later start times increased attendance. A parent post says later dismissal complicates childcare. What is the perspective difference?
options: The parent denies any schedule change.
The report highlights attendance; the parent highlights a family scheduling cost.
They disagree on whether school exists.

optionRationales.reason: Both focus only on lunch.：未提。
The parent denies any schedule change.：反而談 dismissal。
The report highlights attendance; the parent highlights a family scheduling cost.：同政策不同結果面向。
They disagree on whether school exists.：荒謬。

把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The report highlights attendance; the parent highlights a family scheduling cost. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
